comment: Proposed handover of the approval-chain fixture. Each member moves one cell along the open path, keeping one axis leaf fixed per move: H1 -> x2|y1, H2 -> x2|y2, H3 -> x1|y2, H4 -> x1|y3. The edges H1-H2, H2-H3, H3-H4 make one connected group of four. H5 changes its amount at an unrelated rectangle (isolated group). H3's new value is zero on purpose; every book stays publishable.
